statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent dizziness
The patient has a history of atrial fibrillation
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
The patient has underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with arrhythmic events
The service was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
